messages:
maria: Heads-up — preflight for AP-SE2 cluster next week. Need GPU quota + fallback plan. Target: 40 H100s for initial soak, 80A equivalent for burst. Opening thread to coordinate quota appeal + temporary spot mix.

raj: Can you paste the quota template? also which regions/providers?

maria: Provider: GCP ap-southeast2 primary, fallback to AWS ap-southeast-1. Template below:

```
Project: redwood-prod-aps2
Requested quota: 40 GPUs (H100), GCE quota type: GPUs_ALL_REGIONS
Reason: cluster bring-up + e2e perf testing 3/1-3/7
Contact: raj@redwood.com
```

chloe: VPC peering needs pre-approval — network team requires CIDR list and expected egress (TB/day). We need NAT throughput estimate.

zach: For fallback: plan B is mix 20 H100 + 60 A100 (quantized models), and auto-route latency-sensitive traffic to dedicated regional pool. We should pre-create machine images.

maria: Perf numbers: baseline 60 p95 tokens/sec per H100; soak will need 10k concurrent sessions worst case. Estimate egress 2TB/day.

ops-qa-bot: (auto) Created quota ticket GC-2026-8742 and assigned to cloud-quotas. Status: pending. :package:

raj: I'll own the appeal. Quick Q: do we have credits or reserved capacity budget? Cost ops?

maria: Finance ok for 2-week reserved hold. Ops to request temporary capacity hold with billing tag 'aps2-onboard'.

chloe: Also adding checklist item: verify subnet MTU for RDMA (if using GPUDirect) — test command:

```
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1
ping -s 8972 <peer_ip>
```

zach: Preflight test plan (short):
- validate kernel + cuda driver
- run KV-bench with 128 seq
- simulate burst with 5k sessions
- failover test: throttle region and verify routing

maria: handoff: raj -> on quota & tickets, chloe -> network sig-off, zach -> image build + perf smoke, ops-qa -> test matrix.

ops-qa-bot: (auto) Added checklist item: 'create canary traffic profile' to GC-2026-8742

raj: I'll ping cloud-quotas and link the perf report. ETA: EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

chloe: one more: if GCP can't deliver H100s we'll request CMEK exception for private deployment to use A100 instead (compliance check).

maria: thanks — will draft fallback runbook and post in #eng-infra ops-playbooks once tickets in place.

zach: ack. I'll prepare image cache + startup hooks.

raj: update: cloud-quotas replied, need workload PID and expected sustained vCPU numbers — sending now.

maria: pasted PID: RED-APS2-9876 and vCPU estimate 12k sustained.

ops-qa-bot: (auto) Ticket GC-2026-8742 updated: awaiting cloud contact. Last action by raj.

maria: if no quota by Fri, plan schedule to fallback to mixed fleet and staggered rollout schedule.

chloe: noted. I'll schedule peering signoff meeting with network for Thu 10am. :calendar:

raj: leaving note: will update thread when cloud-quotas confirms.
